name: cf-templates-shortlinks
description: A link shortener with an admin panel behind Cloudflare Access: create short codes, share /s/<code>, and the Worker redirects to the full URL.

scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && wrangler deploy --dry-run

LINKS.description: Stores each short code and the full URL it opens.

RATE_LIMITER.description: Caps each visitor at 100 requests a minute on short links and 100 on the API, so one visitor cannot flood them for everyone.

LINKS_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Token your own server sends as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to create links through the API. Use a long random value, for example from `openssl rand -base64 32`.

ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Sites a link may point to, separated by commas, for example `ianmenethil.com,docs.ianmenethil.com`.

BRAND_NAME.description: Company name shown in the admin panel.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain, for example `https://menethil.cloudflareaccess.com`. The admin panel stays locked until this and `ACCESS_AUD` are set.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Application Audience (AUD) Tag of the Access application that protects `/admin`.
